verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an API for reading or managing bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe suppression lists. The nearby items cover different capabilities: bounce and unsubscribe analytics tracking, pre-send email verification, domain/IP blocklist monitoring, and event webhooks. None of these is a suppression-list management API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can read and manage bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists via the API so my app never re-emails a hard bounce
